findings.issue: The verified GitHub login and numeric user ID are displayed, but the required link to that user's GitHub profile is not rendered.
findings.consequence: The owner cannot directly verify the connected acting account from the account page as required by the accepted connection behavior.
findings.fix: Render a safely encoded link to the fixed https://github.com/{verified-login} profile URL (with appropriate rel attributes), and cover it in account UI tests.

findings.issue: After a fresh repository-authority check succeeds, a transient run/issue collection failure returns an `unavailable` result and replaces the cache result; no last-known observation/source timestamps are returned with a stale indication. The supported README explicitly promises that temporary transport failure retains old source times with a stale warning.
findings.consequence: A transient source outage drops the last-known evidence rather than preserving the documented stale/unavailable distinction, so the operational view loses useful context and does not meet the stated adapter behavior.
findings.fix: After rechecking current repository authority, retain and return the last successful observation on transient collection failures with an explicit stale state/reason and original source timestamps; never treat stale data as current permission. Add a deterministic regression test. If stale retention is intentionally out of scope, revise the accepted design/docs and tests instead of claiming the existing behavior.
